endorsements.name: Collin Mulliner
endorsements.label: Advanced Attacks Against PocketPC Phones
endorsements.description: Advanced Attacks Against PocketPC Phones Collin Mulliner Abstract: Smart phones are the new favorite target of many attackers. Also most current attacks are harmless, since these mostly rely on user mistake or lack of better knowledge. Current attacks are mostly based on logic errors rather then code inject and often are only found by accident. The talk will show some real attacks against smart phones and the kind of vulnerability analysis which lead to their discovery. Bio: Collin Mulliner is a computer science student/researcher and a member of the trifinite.group . Collin's main interest are mobile devices, their security and pretty much everything that is somehow related. Collin started poking PalmOS-based PDAs in 1997, and by now has laid his hands on pretty much every existing type of portable device. In recent years Collin was mainly messing around with Bluetooth and created the first Bluetooth port-scanner. Lately Collin's main focus shifted towards PocketPC-based smart phones.
